#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int l;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> l >> s;

    int max = 0;
    int num = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    std::string wd;

    for (int i = 0; i < l; ++i) {
        char ch = s[i];
        switch (ch) {
            case '(':
                max = std::max(max, (int)wd.length());
                wd.clear();
                inside = true;
                break;
            case ')':
                if (wd.length() != 0) num++;
                inside = false;
                wd.clear();
                break;
            case '_':
                if (inside) {
                    if (wd.length() != 0) num++;
                } else {
                    max = std::max(max, (int)wd.length());
                }
                wd.clear();
                break;
            default:
                wd.push_back(ch);
                if (i == l - 1) max = std::max(max, (int)wd.length());
                break;
        }
    }

    std::cout << max << " " << num << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
